derivation.length_note: Two input S-bends + DC coupling region + two output S-bends. Ls=40um (each S-bend), L=17.5um (coupling-region length), from p3: 'Ls = 40 um and L = 17.5 um'. Matches manifest max_footprint_um[0]=100.
derivation.width_note: Transverse bounding box at the fan-out ends where the gap is widest. Paper p3: 'the gap increases gradually from 0.9 um to 2.9 um from the DC region', waveguide width W=1.1um. Outer-edge to outer-edge = 2.9 + 2*1.1 = 5.1um. (In the DC region the transverse extent is only g_dc + 2*W = 0.9 + 2*1.1 = 3.1um.)
